geometry: one-dimensional left marginal cluster of odd size n1
iforest_detection: maximum anomaly expected depth is below minimum normal expected depth
knn_detection: minimum anomaly k-NN mean distance is above maximum normal score
within_cluster_gaps: minimum 1 and maximum kappa in both clusters
constraint_limit: k/n1 is asymptotic to sqrt(n1) and k/n0 is asymptotic to 1/sqrt(n1)
